module.purpose: Defines authenticated NestJS HTTP endpoints for requesting verification codes, verifying email and phone resources, and listing or retrieving a user's verified contact resources.
module.summary: This controller is the API boundary for verified email and phone resources. It applies authentication, API documentation, endpoint throttling for verification-code operations, pagination for collection reads, and delegates business operations to a dedicated service. Successful responses consistently include a status and transform service results into output DTOs.
module.businessContext: Supports account contact verification and retrieval of verified user contact methods. Failures can prevent users from confirming contact ownership or accessing verified-resource data.

edgeCases.inputShape: Service rejection or thrown domain error
edgeCases.behavior: The error propagates to NestJS error handling because no local catch or fallback exists.

errorHandling.action: No local error handling is performed; rejected service promises propagate to the framework.

invariants.description: Each endpoint awaits its service operation before constructing the response.
Verification-code requests return SUCCESS_STATUS when the service result is truthy and ERROR_STATUS otherwise.
Verification and lookup responses always use SUCCESS_STATUS when the service call resolves.
Collection results are converted to output DTO instances before being returned.
Collection pagination defaults skip to zero and take to 250 when values are nullish.

assumptions.description: Requests provide authentication recognized by ApiAuthGuard and user values exposed through GetUser.
Input and pagination DTOs have already validated request bodies and query values before controller execution.
NestJS dependency injection supplies an initialized VerifiedResourcesService instance.

ambiguities.question: What concrete exceptions can the verified resources service throw, and how are they mapped by global framework handlers?

concurrencyModel.notes: Methods are stateless at the controller level and await independent service calls. Throttling is enforced by decorators for verification-code endpoints.
